files.disposition: Types, uploaded filtering, upload gate predicate and legacy normalization only. attachmentToDraftUpload clears both ephemeral signed URL fields while preserving durable URL/markdown URL; already-shaped uploaded records are accepted after shape checks. Reload drops uploading records because File bytes are not persisted; failed/interrupted legacy records remain. No resume, retry or resource load.
Re-export barrel only. create-draft-store is exported, not invoked here; coordinator and cleanup exports retain the dispositions in this batch. No transport on barrel evaluation established.

Injected api.uploadFile receives File, optional issue/comment/chat context and AbortSignal. Active coordinated caller supplies singleton api, resolving to client:4078 multipart POST. Map owns controller lifetime independently of editor mount. Success invokes onSettled; abort errors suppress settlement; other errors settle failed. Finally removes only matching controller. abortUpload/abortAll cancel locally, no DELETE or server cancellation route. A successful promise resolving after abort is not separately signal-guarded in success branch; caller generation guards matter.

Injected ApiClient uploadFile resolves to multipart client:4078 in active editor evidence. Rejects oversized File before call; in-flight counter increments/decrements in finally. uploadWithToast invokes supplied onError then returns null. toUploadResult preserves raw url as link and selects markdown_url, durable attachment-ID download path, then raw url. Computing links loads no bytes; no File is constructed or persisted here.

Pure grouping and lookup: normalize MIME/filename, deduplicate attachment IDs, sort versions by date/id, newest-first deliverables. Inventory synthesizes comment entries only with complete origin; timeline comments override inventory including tombstones. No listing/fetch is performed despite inventory terminology.

Pure URL matching, Markdown AST/reference definitions, HTML img attribute parsing/entity decode and file-card scanning excluding code ranges; bounded LRU stores content refs only. Match stable download/local upload IDs then normalized URL equality ignoring query/fragment. Select standalone excludes referenced duplicates; order images before files; collect walks inline then standalone, applies injected inclusion predicate and deduplicates keys. URL priority download_url, markdown_url, url, reference; collectImageSequence supplies local image predicate. No Image, fetch, DOM or resource load; later preview consumers load resources as existing editor evidence describes.

Singleton api is injected into startUpload, finite target client:4078. File limit checked before placeholder/request. Snapshots draft target and context; local or persisted placeholders share editor upload ID. Registry acts as local editor ownership lease with identity-checked cleanup and loaded-key matching. Generation checks prevent stale write-back; unmounted success delivers markdown through editor replacement/insert or store append with bounded timer retries. Rebuild retries create local placeholders only. Failure removes placeholder and restores pasted source text; no resumable bytes. removeUpload aborts tracked uploading request then removes local record; gate combines document truth with current store/ref placeholders. No attachment DELETE. Aborted coordinator does not settle the returned wrapper Promise.

Every invocation refetches metadata directly: workspace getAttachment client:4438 or markdown-link getAttachmentForDownload client:4447, bypassing stale query data. Desktop prefers fresh attachment_download_url then download_url, resolves API-relative URL and invokes injected downloadURL; missing URL/errors toast. Web prefers forced attachment_download_url, then only site-relative /api/attachments/ signed-download capability from download_url, else requires workspace slug and clicks unified /download?workspace_slug=... . Temporary anchor uses download attribute and is removed. Absolute inline download_url is deliberately excluded from web capability fallback. No renderer blob buffering here. Server-returned forced URL is passed through resolver without canonical-route inference.

React state exposes reactive uploading; imperative isBlocked reads editorRef.hasActiveUploads at invocation. No submission/upload operation. Host submit semantics reused from composer-submit coverage.
